verdicts.title: Applications of Level Curves to Some Problems on Algebraic Surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: In a previous work of the authors, a result to algorithmically compute the topology types of the level curves of an algebraic surface, is given. From this result, here we derive applications based on level curves to determine some topological features of surfaces (reality, compactness, connectivity) and to the problem of plotting.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract discusses applications of level curves to algebraic surfaces, but does not mention twisted Hodge structures or DPLL search trees, making it orthogonal to the conjecture.

verdicts.title: On large families of bundles over algebraic surfaces
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The aim of this note is to construct sequences of vector bundles with unbounded rank and discriminant on an arbitrary algebraic surface. This problem, on principally polarized abelian varieties with cyclic Neron-Severi group generated by the polarization, was considered by Nakashima in connection with the Douglas-Reinbacher-Yau conjecture on the Strong Bogomolov Inequality. In particular we show that on any surface, the Strong Bogomolov Inequality $SBI_l$ is false for all $l>4$.
